title: Self-contained (1, 1) for OR_n: every B2 circuit needs n-1 gates

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"OR: L is the set of binary strings containing at least one 1, so f_n=OR_n on {0,1}^n for every n>=0, with f_0(empty)=0. A fixed linear-time scan computes f_n at every length; the NP verifier is V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the scan accepts x, with witness bound W(n)=0.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(OR_n)>=n-1 at every integer length n=|x|>=2 in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model, so liminf over all integer n of C_B2(OR_n)/n>=1.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
